# Project rules for todo-app

## Tooling
- Use pnpm for everything. Never use npm or yarn in this repo.
- Never add a new dependency without asking me first.

## Git
- Run `pnpm test` before every commit, and only commit if it passes.
- Never commit .env files or anything containing secrets.
- Write commit messages in Conventional Commits format (feat:, fix:, chore:).
- Never run `git push --force`.

## Safety
- Ask before deleting any file.
